reason: Fresh-main V5 successor for the delegated first-head evaluator repair. V4 authorization PR #585 ordinary-merged validly as aefda31e3a4708a0cbd330bc5f5f426c4a1e3ef1, but its implementation remained at zero commits. Before the immutable first tests-only head could be created, PR #587 advanced trusted main to eb3c92c8152a22e0eaf9c5dffcfdd57bb3a24231. V4's own exact firstHeadTrustedMainGuard therefore forbids starting its implementation. The evaluator and paired policy-test blobs remain byte-identical on the fresh base, so V5 preserves the exact same two-path causal repair and supersedes only the unstarted V4 implementation authority.

requiredSemantics: Only delegated authorizations that explicitly declare the exact first-head trusted-main guard acquire the new behavior.
On the unique first failure-first implementation head, trusted main must still equal the effective authorization merge commit.
If trusted main advanced before that first head is evaluated, fail closed with WP0_DELEGATED_GOVERNANCE_FIRST_HEAD_MAIN_DRIFT before the head can count as causal RED evidence.
After a valid first failure-first head, existing delegated-governance fresh-main refresh semantics remain unchanged.
Existing authorizations without the declaration preserve current behavior.
The declaration itself is parsed strictly: malformed, weakened or extra-key shapes fail authorization validation.
